items.title: Josef Balcerak Interview, 1968-05-17
items.q: Like Benny Goodman, uh, Duke Ellington, Teddy Wilson, and so on, and so on.

ctx.x: And, uh, did you hear any jazz when you were, uh, growing up as a child?

Of course. No, first time I have, uh, my first contact with jazz was after my school education. And my first job I got in Warsaw at the branch of American film company United Artists and London, London Films from London. Uh, as a clerk and then as a chief of publicity and press department, before of my previous experience in journalist life. Uh, and in my office, uh, exactly in the same department, uh, I had a friend, Jackie Rotvandowna, girl, uh, who was very interested in jazz life and make plenty of journeys…
Mm-hmm. Did, how long did this last that you could listen to jazz? Was it interrupted? Stopped?
